description: Image Description: The image depicts a scene in a grassy area, possibly part of a zoo or wildlife reserve. In the foreground, there is a zebra standing on the grass, bending its neck down as if grazing. The zebra's black and white stripes are clearly visible. To the right, the hindquarters of another zebra are partially visible, suggesting a small group of zebras in the area. In front of the zebra in the foreground, there is a large, horizontal tree log lying on the grass
